title: A room forgotten here keeps its members' client counts until some other room's epoch moves
description:
sync::refresh_clients (bead mimid-1wgh.140.5) runs under the moved-epoch gate in Store::sync, which is reliable because every leaf added or removed moves a room's epoch. Store::forget_room moves none: it deletes the records here. The room is then skipped by the pass's walk (is_forgotten), so a member of only that room should drop to 0 -- but the pass does not run until some other room's epoch moves, so until then MONITOR keeps reporting them reachable.

Named as a limitation at mimid-agent-store's crate docs and at the field, with no test. Either call refresh_clients from forget_room's path, or mark the gate dirty there, and add the test.
